caption: The drawing depicts a long, knee-length coat with wide, loose sleeves and a flaring hem. The coat is colored in a beige or light brown shade with fine, closely spaced vertical and diagonal lines to suggest texture. Each major seam, edge, and outline of the garment is accentuated with a blue or teal line. The coat features a series of six sets of diamond-shaped decorations with two small round fasteners or buttons inside each, running down the center front, oriented in pairs that mirror each other on each side of the central opening. The inner side of the sleeves is visible and colored a paler shade, with the same blue or teal outlining. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present. The name "MARY FITZGERALD" is written in small, uppercase letters in the lower right corner.
title: Evening Cloak
